name: Gasthof Gemse
beschreibung: The Gasthof Gemse is located in the municipality of Prutz in the Tyrolean Oberland. The inn is situated in a quiet setting surrounded by the magnificent mountain peaks of the Tyrolean Alps. Traditionally managed, the property offers simple yet well-maintained accommodation. In the in-house restaurant, guests can savour authentic regional specialities. The guest rooms are functionally equipped with an en-suite bathroom and WC. A pleasant guest garden is available for relaxation during the summer months. The surrounding region is ideal for hiking in summer and skiing in winter. Prutz is a central hub in the Tyrolean Oberland, serving as a practical base for excursions.
